detail.goal: look up member 67890 and read their savings balance

detail.why: The Member ID textbox is the input for the member number we want to look up; it is identified by the adjacent "Member ID" label.

detail.target: button named "Search" follows "Search Type" in frame "main"
detail.why: Submit the inquiry with Search Type left at "Member Number", which matches looking up by member ID.

This is the Balance-column value on the row labelled "Savings" in the Account/Balance table, i.e. the member's savings balance. Anchoring to the "Savings" row label keeps it findable when amounts change.
Records the account holder's name beside the "Name" label, confirming the balance belongs to the intended member.

detail.summary: Searched Member Inquiry for member ID 67890 with Search Type "Member Number", landing on the Member Detail screen for Marcus Webb (Status: Active). Savings balance is $812.30 (Checking is $95.00). Checkpoint is the stable "Savings" row label in the Account/Balance table.
